# Celebrate Lighting

> Celebrate Lighting installs permanent outdoor LED lighting for homes and businesses across Southwestern Ontario. Track-mounted, colour-matched, app-controlled systems that are weatherproof to −40°C and backed by a lifetime warranty — so homeowners never climb a ladder to hang seasonal lights again.

## Business details
- Name: Celebrate Lighting
- Address: 631 Peel Street, Woodstock, ON N4S 1K1, Canada
- Phone: 519-266-6796
- Email: contact@celebratelighting.ca
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8 AM–8 PM, Sat 9 AM–6 PM, Sun 10 AM–4 PM
- Service area: St. Thomas, London, Stratford, Brantford, Tillsonburg, Waterloo, Guelph, Woodstock (and surrounding Southwestern Ontario)
- Rating: 5.0/5 from homeowners across Southwestern Ontario
- Warranty: lifetime warranty on LED lights, mounting hardware, and workmanship

## What makes the service distinct
- Permanent, year-round system — one professional installation replaces seasonal light hanging forever.
- Track-mounted and colour-matched to your soffit and fascia for a clean, hidden look.
- App-controlled over WiFi: 16M+ colours, brightness, schedules, and pre-set holiday themes from your phone.
- Commercial-grade, IP67-rated LEDs rated to −40°C and 50,000+ hours, built for Canadian winters.
- Licensed and insured electrical contractors; lifetime warranty including free repairs and replacements.

## Services
- New Installation: custom permanent LED track lighting, colour-matched, with app setup. https://celebratelighting.ca/services/new-installation
- Repair Service: diagnosis and repair of any permanent lighting system, most repairs same-day. https://celebratelighting.ca/services/repair-service
- Consultation: free, no-pressure in-home design and quote. https://celebratelighting.ca/services/consultation
- Maintenance: annual inspection, cleaning, and firmware updates. https://celebratelighting.ca/services/maintenance
- Replace Existing Lights: upgrade an older system to premium app-controlled LED. https://celebratelighting.ca/services/replace-existing-lights
